command: set -e; echo '=== VOICE FILES ==='; find /var/lib/entityos/voice -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*.py' -printf '%p\n' | sort; echo '=== SPEAKER/IDENTITY ==='; grep -RniE 'sprecher|speaker|voiceprint|identit|owner|andreas|gabriel' /var/lib/entityos/voice 2>/dev/null | head -180 || true; echo '=== LOOP FUNCTIONS ==='; grep -RniE '^def |^class |transcript|speech_stopped|response.create|tool|auftrag|memory|state' /var/lib/entityos/voice/gespraech_loop.py 2>/dev/null | head -220 || true; echo '=== SERVICE UNIT ==='; systemctl cat entityos-vm.service 2>/dev/null || true
